title: ci(linting): make linting a separate step in the build matrix
body:
**Summary**

When "unit tests" fail on Travis, it's most of the time linting, which takes more time to process. If you see a failure for "linting", you directly know how to fix it, without even needing to look at the logs

**Result**

Unit testing and linting are a separate "failure".
Also changed some smaller things to be more consistent with Yarn usage and file location
